The issue concerns a bug in the `datasets` library where the `map` and `filter` functions do not work correctly when using multiprocessing with the newer version 2.6.0. def preprocess(example):

```python
ds1 = ds.map(preprocess, num_proc=2)
ds2 = ds.map(preprocess)

ds_filtered_2 = ds2.filter(lambda x: not x["autogenerated"])
```
